EmailTemplate.description: QCC: Contact centre compliment request email template will be sent 2pm the following day when the request was raised.CRM-8664
EmailTemplate.name: QCC_Contact_Centre_Letter_3C
EmailTemplate.subject: Qantas Customer Care - {!Case.CaseNumber}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Ref No: {!Case.CaseNumber}
Dear {!Case.Contact}
Thank you so much for writing to us, we always appreciate your feedback.
Our staff love to hear from loyal customers like you when they have been able to make your booking process a little bit easier, and will be so grateful for your kind words. I’ve passed your comments on to our Contact Centre management to let them know what you had to say.
Thank you again from all of us at Qantas and we look forward to seeing you onboard again soon.
Kind regards
Qantas Customer Care
Note: This email was sent from a notification only address that cannot accept incoming email. Please do not reply to this message.
